echoParts: in the heavens and on the earth
verseText: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
meaning: God has the power to do whatever he feels like, wherever he wants: all the way from heaven above down to the bottom of the sea.
